Natural materials. Open air. Timber, thatch, weave, salt air. Nothing polished to perfection. Not entirely sealed away from the elements.

Every structure at Floating Paradise is built from natural materials that live in relationship with the sea, the sun, the wind and the rain, they fade and weather. They require care. They need replacing. The roof is renewed. The wood is tended. The details are revisited again and again.
Living off-grid is not a shortcut. It is daily
You are supporting craftsmanship. Renewable energy. Natural materials. Cyclical rebuilding. Human hands. Long-term care.

Built by hand and shaped by the elements, each bungalow has its own personality; no two are the same. Wake with the sunrise shimmering across the water, watch the tide shift beneath your feet, and fall asleep to the quiet rhythm of the waves.

Inside, natural textures and open design create a space that feels both grounded and free. Each bungalow features a queen bed (or larger), a private ensuite with fresh water shower, sink, and flushing toilet, and a generous balcony with comfortable seating; your front-row seat to panoramic views of the sea and mangroves.

As part of the journey, youʼll have the opportunity to plant a sapling at the top, contributing directly to the islandʼs reforestation efforts. Itʼs not just a hike, itʼs a way to leave a living footprint.
At Floating, meals are slow, fresh, and deeply local; shaped by the sea, the seasons, and what the island provides that day.

Our kitchen celebrates the flavours of Karimunjawa with fragrant Indonesian classics, freshly caught fish, tender squid, vibrant vegetable dishes, and nourishing plant-based options. Every plate is prepared to
order using local ingredients, served with rice, seasonal vegetables, and fresh fruit.
We donʼt rush food here. Ingredients are sourced daily and dishes are prepared fresh, which is why we kindly ask guests to pre-order lunch and dinner.
At the bar, youʼll find chilled long drinks, cold beers, fresh juices, coconuts, and good coffee; simple, refreshing companions to island living.

Floating is designed for guests who appreciate nature, simplicity and being close to the elements. If you are looking for polished resort infrastructure, Karimunjawa may feel different. If you enjoy authenticity, sea air and a slower rhythm, you will feel very at home.
